You need sign-off from **the Growth team**. Post the change in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve it.

The notifier moved to Growth on 2026-09-01. Dana Okafor used to own it, but she has moved to Platform, so she's no longer the one to ask. This comes from the team's shared project memory. The repo itself has no CODEOWNERS or OWNERS file that says who owns what.

**An outdated record:** the shared memory still has an older entry ("Who owns the notifier") saying Dana has to approve template and copy changes. The newer entry replaces it, but the old one is still marked active, so someone else could be told the wrong person. I can mark it as outdated if you'd like.

**When you make the edit:** the receipt template lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. It has a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, that needs the same wording change and the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
